description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003, Fiscal Management Report - 2024
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the publication and availability of the Fiscal Management Report 2024, which is issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance with fiscal management legislation, specifically referencing Sections 4 and 7 of the Act. It deals with statutory reporting requirements and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
